sample_return_dates: 2014-01-01 through 2026-08-31; only valid Nikkei trading dates with an available prior valid close form daily returns.
initial_position_rule: The first eligible 2014 return is LONG. Previous position is FLAT, so the first eligible trading day pays one one-way cost unit.
half_year_transition_rule: On the first eligible return date in July, LONG to SHORT costs two one-way units. On the first eligible return date in January, SHORT to LONG costs two one-way units.
final_sample_rule: 2026-08-31 is a mark-to-market sample endpoint. No artificial terminal liquidation cost is charged because there is no position change in the frozen strategy at the sample boundary.
cost_allocation: Subtract the applicable bps cost from that transition day's strategy return before monthly compounding.
